newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil unchanged, but slow except barges.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil unchanged, but slow except barges.

text.p: NWE cracked fuel was slow on Friday with little interest shown for cargo-sized lots.

There was more activity on the barge market spurred on by reasonable bunker demand of around 15,000 tonnes. Prompt barrels were under pressure, a follow-on from problems caused last week at Esso Nederlands' flexi-coker unit.
Barges traded at $111 a tonne fob ARA for prompt material while second half January barrels were sold for $115.
"The contango into January has been exaggerated by the extra fuel coming onto the market (because of the flexi-coker problem), but that's been and gone now," said one trader.

Cargoes markets were pegged unchanged. Dealers said there was an absence of trades making it difficult to assess price movements. They said the market would take until the middle of next week before it got into its stride.
